articles.title: Starbucks Will Close 250 More Cafes as Part of CEO Niccol’s Turnaround Plan
articles.summary: Starbucks announced another round of closures for locations across the U.S. and Canada on Thursday. The company cited CEO Brian Niccol’s yearslong strategy to revive its brand and boost profitability. Chief Operating Officer Mike Grams said Starbucks will close about 250 cafes in North America, representing about 1% of its 18,000 locations.

articles.summary: Starbucks (NASDAQ:SBUX) plans to close 250 underperforming stores in North America and expects to record approximately $300 million in restructuring charges related to the move, according to a regulatory filing. The planned closures represent about 1% of Starbucks’ approximately 18,000 locations across North America.
